mapper.insert: insert into user_book_list (user_id, list_name, description, book_count, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{listName}, #{description}, #{bookCount}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update user_book_list set book_count = case when book_count + #{delta} < 0 then 0 else book_count + #{delta} end, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select t1.id, t1.user_id, t1.list_name, t1.description, t1.book_count, t1.status, t1.create_time, t1.update_time, IFNULL(NULLIF(t2.nick_name, ''), t2.username) create_user_name, t2.user_photo create_user_photo from user_book_list t1 inner join user t2 on t1.user_id = t2.id where t1.id = #{id}

select t1.id, t1.user_id, t1.list_name, t1.description, t1.book_count, t1.status, t1.create_time, t1.update_time, IFNULL(NULLIF(t2.nick_name, ''), t2.username) create_user_name, t2.user_photo create_user_photo from user_book_list t1 inner join user t2 on t1.user_id = t2.id where t1.user_id = #{userId} and t1.status = 1 order by t1.update_time desc

select t1.id, t1.user_id, t1.list_name, t1.description, t1.book_count, t1.status, t1.create_time, t1.update_time, IFNULL(NULLIF(t2.nick_name, ''), t2.username) create_user_name, t2.user_photo create_user_photo from user_book_list t1 inner join user t2 on t1.user_id = t2.id where t1.status = 1 order by t1.book_count desc, t1.create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into user_book_list_item (list_id, book_id, remark, create_time) values (#{listId}, #{bookId}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: delete from user_book_list_item where list_id = #{listId} and book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.select: select t1.book_id, t1.remark, t1.create_time, t2.book_name, t2.author_name, t2.pic_url, t2.cat_name, t2.book_status from user_book_list_item t1 inner join book t2 on t1.book_id = t2.id where t1.list_id = #{listId} and t2.status = 1 order by t1.create_time desc
